[[Regent-Lady Celia Harlow|Celia]] (sister) }} '''Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow''' is a [[human]] located in [[Greymane Tower]] in [[Gilneas City]]. Ostensibly Alteraci nobles sent to the court of King [[Genn Greymane]] by Lord [[Daval Prestor]], Mortimer and his sister were black dragonspawn tasked by their father with infiltrating the kingdom of Gilneas and bringing it to ruin from within. Although they successfully integrated themselves among Genn's courtiers and advisors, soon poisoning the mind of the king and manipulating him into against his people, they lost contact with their father and received no more word from him.[[Celia's Journal]] While awaiting for orders, Mortimer soon started to enjoy the life of a human nobleman and began to lavish in the desires of mortals and even taking himself a wife among the Gilneans - the daughter of [[Lord Darius Ravenwood]], [[Elena Ravenwood|Elena]]. ==Objective of== * {{questlong|Alliance|47D|Undoing Draconic Presence}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Harlow, Mortimer}} [[Category:Black dragonspawn]] [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Gilneas City mobs]] [[Category:Bosses]]
